name: dumbbell one arm triceps extension
description: A single-arm overhead extension with a dumbbell. It isolates the triceps and builds arm strength.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and press it overhead.
Keep your upper arm close to your head with the elbow pointing up.
Bend the elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend the elbow to press the weight back up.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
